meta.title: Data window
meta.description: A DataGrip-style database window: the workspace's own configuration supplies each environment's host and credentials, so the tree shows instances, databases, tables and columns, F4 shows one table's create statement, and every database gets its own read-only SQL workbench.

filterPlaceholder: Filter the loaded databases and tables
treeEmpty: No database configuration found for this workspace
browseAllDatabases: List every database on this instance
sqlPlaceholder: Write a SELECT statement, then press ⌘/Ctrl + Enter
ddlFailed: Could not read the create statement
ddlEmpty: The server returned an empty create statement
resultHint: Press ⌘/Ctrl + Enter in the editor to run the statement
refreshHint: Re-read the workspace configuration and the Nacos cache
emptyHint: Open a workspace and the window reads its own configuration: the Nacos cache supplies each environment's host and credentials, and every database in it gets a SQL workbench.
emptyReadyHint: Click a database in the explorer to open its SQL workbench, or a table to see its columns. Double-click a table to open its rows.
shortcutSummary: F4 or ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + D on a table shows its create statement · ⌘/Ctrl + Enter runs the statement · every statement is read-only
discoveringHint: Looking for bootstrap.yml, the Nacos snapshot cache and the data-ids that define the placeholders
log.discoverFailed: Could not read the workspace configuration: {message}
log.hostRestarted: The Host restarted; re-reading the configuration and retrying
log.databasesFailed: Could not list the databases of this instance: {message}
log.noStatement: There is no statement to run
log.pickFailed: Could not open the directory picker: {message}
error.readOnly: This window only runs queries, so the write was blocked
error.hostRestarted: The Host forgot this connection; retrying once
error.databaseRequired: Pick a database before running this
error.noSuchTable: The table does not exist in this database
error.badField: The statement names a column that does not exist
error.timeout: The database did not answer in time
error.unresolved: The database host could not be resolved
error.interrupted: The statement was interrupted by the server
emptyNoEnvTitle: This workspace resolved no data source
emptyNoEnvHint: The window reads only this project's own spring.datasource entries: the application name in bootstrap.yml must match a Nacos snapshot, and the data source must be a jdbc:mysql URL. Other data-ids in the snapshot are read only for the ${…} values they define — no file name is assumed — and instances declared elsewhere are never listed.
warning.project-no-application-name: The project's bootstrap.yml declares no spring.application.name, so the window matched configuration by directory name.
warning.nacos-cache-missing: No local Nacos cache was found under ~/nacos/config; start the service once so the Nacos client writes its snapshot.
warning.no-environment: No data source declared by this project could be resolved; only databases from this project's own configuration are read.
warning.unparsed-jdbc-url: A datasource URL could not be parsed as jdbc:mysql.
resizeTree: Drag to resize the list (double-click resets)
formatSqlHint: Beautify the statement (keyword case is kept)
settingsIntro: These options only affect the data window and are kept in this browser.
settingsAutoHideHint: Applies when the window is at least 1024px wide; with this off the sidebar stays as it is, and the toolbar button still folds it.
settingsLimitHint: Used by new queries; the limit control above the grid still overrides it for one run.
settingsShortcutHint: Press this shortcut anywhere to open the data window.
countRowsHint: Run one COUNT query for the current statement (read-only)
settingsShortcutsHint: Shortcuts are editable, and future ones will be listed here.
settingsShortcutRecordingHint: Press the new combination (⌘/Ctrl/⌥ required); Esc cancels.
settingsThemeHint: Follows the theme chosen in the code workspace (dsh-ide-window); with none chosen, DSH colours are used.
aiOpenHint: Let a model read the workspace configuration for addresses the rules missed
aiEmptyHint: When the rules do not recognise this project's configuration shape, a model can read the workspace. Every proposed address is proven with a real connection first; unproven ones stay out of the tree.
aiLoadingModels: Reading the models configured in DSH…
aiNoModels: DSH has no usable model: configure a provider in Settings, then come back.
aiNoLlm: The Host exposes no LLM service, so AI analysis is unavailable.
aiProviderFailed: This provider failed to list models: {message}
aiPrivacy: Only redacted configuration excerpts are sent (password values become <redacted>). The model returns file and key paths; the Host reads the secret itself and proves every address with a read-only connection.
aiRunningHint: Up to 2 minutes. The Host then tries each proposed address; ones that do not connect stay out of the tree.
aiDoneEmpty: None of the proposed addresses connected
aiDoneHint: Verified addresses joined the “AI” group in the tree; failures are listed below and written to the run log.
aiBusy: An AI analysis is already running
settingsAiModelHint: Used to read the workspace when the rules resolve no database configuration. Proposed addresses are verified by a real connection before they reach the tree.
warning.ai-no-evidence: No configuration excerpt the model could read was found in the workspace.
warning.ai-candidate-unresolved: A proposed address cited no resolvable account or password, so it was ignored.
warning.ai-connect-failed: A proposed address refused the connection and was ignored.
warning.ai-unvalidated: The Host cannot validate connections, so the AI result is unverified.
manualOpenHint: Add a database connection by hand (independent of the workspace configuration)
manualHint: For databases neither the rules nor the AI can find: a local container, a shared test instance, a customer's replica. The connection is tested once before it is saved; a failed test writes nothing.
manualLabelHint: Connections sharing a name form one environment group; an empty name falls back to “host:port”
manualDatabaseHint: Leave empty to add the instance only; then use “List every database on this instance”
manualPrivacy: The Host stores these settings (password included) in a 0600 file under this workspace's storage directory; the browser only receives connection ids, and every query still passes the read-only gateway.
aiManualInstead: Or enter the connection by hand
log.remembered: Remembered this database for the workspace: {database}
log.forgetDatabaseFailed: Could not remove the remembered database: {message}
schemaHint: Checked databases appear in the tree and are remembered for this workspace; the configured ones always stay.
schemaFailed: Could not read the database list
manualFromSavedHint: Connections resolved or added in other workspaces appear here; picking one fills host, port, user and database.
manualSourceHint: The password is reused from that connection and is never shown in the form.
error.savedConnectionMissing: That saved connection no longer exists; enter it again
renameHint: Only the group name changes; databases already picked in this environment stay.
removeEnvironmentHint: Every connection under “{name}” and its picked databases are removed and no longer shown; import it again from another workspace when needed.
log.pageEnd: No more rows: this is the last page
menuCopyUpdateHint: Builds an UPDATE from the edited cells (copied, never executed)
updateNeedsEdits: Double-click a cell and edit it before copying an UPDATE
updateNeedsPrimaryKey: This result has no primary-key column, so no safe WHERE can be built
updateNeedsSingleTable: This statement is not a single-table SELECT; no UPDATE can be built
copyEditsHint: Copy the UPDATE statements of every edited row (copied, never executed)
exportHint: Export the {rows} rows on this page
insertNeedsTable: This is not a single-table SELECT (it uses a join, several tables or a subquery), so the target table is unknown. Export from a single-table query instead.
log.exportDownloaded: This host cannot choose a save location; downloaded {name} to the default downloads folder
editorPasteBlocked: The browser does not allow reading the clipboard; paste with ⌘V
optimizeNoModel: No model selected yet — choose one in Settings → Data window → AI
log.copiedReferenceOnly: Chat input is closed; reference copied: {reference}
